title: audioTestingFiles
responsibility: Emit a headless audio runner config and deterministic PCM playback, interruption and WAV recording service.

outputs.name: audioTestingFiles
outputs.description: The module's only export: an array of {path, contents} file records built once when the module loads, containing each browserTestFiles() entry with the first 'tests/e2e/support' in its path replaced by 'tests/e2e/plugin-support', followed by three fixed files (the headless audio Playwright config, the HeadlessAudioService types file and the HeadlessAudioService.ts source). It matters to any code that reads this exported list; the path rewrite changes only the first match in each path, and the contents of the browserTestFiles() entries are defined outside this file.

examples.contents: export interface AudioChunk { samples: Int16Array; offset: number; }
